![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ4MzU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--88e465239d0b91ec374fa212d7f99fd67bc410a5/400p-%E7%B2%97%E9%A5%BC%E9%A6%96%E9%A1%B5%E7%9A%84logo.png)

After five years, the passion is revival, the long-anticipated Guangdong Open is finally returning. 
On February 6-8, 2026, during the Chinese New Year season, let's gather again in Guangzhou.

With the return of a full combination of WCA events,
Featuring the new "Head-to-Head" format,
And in the midst of a rich festive atmosphere,
Let's write a new chapter together.

The "GAN Cube Cup" Guangdong Open - Revival & Rival, awaits your challenge!
